list.name: fts
list.label: FTS serial
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT module_serial FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT module_serial FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT module_serial AS metric, CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.percentage') AS FLOAT) AS value FROM (SELECT module_serial, payload_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_serial ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.percentage') IS NOT NULL AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring}))) x WHERE rn = 1

SELECT module_serial AS metric, CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.currentVoltage') AS FLOAT) AS value FROM (SELECT module_serial, payload_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_serial ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.currentVoltage') IS NOT NULL AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring}))) x WHERE rn = 1

SELECT module_serial AS serial, ts, JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.charging') AS charging, JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.lastNodeId') AS last_node, JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.driving') AS driving, JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.paused') AS paused FROM (SELECT module_serial, ts, payload_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_serial ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring}))) x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY serial

SELECT DATETRUNC(second, ts) AS time, module_serial AS metric, CAST(AVG(CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.percentage') AS FLOAT)) AS FLOAT) AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.percentage') IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) GROUP BY DATETRUNC(second, ts), module_serial ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATETRUNC(second, ts) AS time, module_serial AS metric, CAST(AVG(CAST(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.currentVoltage') AS FLOAT)) AS FLOAT) AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.batteryState.currentVoltage') IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) GROUP BY DATETRUNC(second, ts), module_serial ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Loads over time (NFC on FTS)
panels.description: One series per NFC seen in FTS state load[]; value = lastNodeId when present.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP 4000 CAST(ts AS datetime2) AS time, CONCAT(workpiece_id, N' · ', COALESCE(workpiece_type, N'?')) AS metric, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.lastNodeId'), N''), N'on-FTS') AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) ORDER BY ts

SELECT TOP 50 ts, module_serial AS serial, workpiece_id AS nfc, workpiece_type AS color, JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.lastNodeId') AS last_node, order_id FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND workpiece_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Actions FINISHED (DOCK / PASS / TURN / PICK / DROP)
panels.description: Current sessions are mostly DOCK/TURN/PASS on FTS state; PICK/DROP often appear on modules during dock.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.action, CAST(ISNULL(c.n, 0) AS FLOAT) AS value FROM (VALUES (N'DOCK'), (N'PASS'), (N'TURN'), (N'PICK'), (N'DROP')) AS a(action) LEFT JOIN (SELECT action, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%' AND action_state = N'FINISHED' AND action IN (N'DOCK', N'PASS', N'TURN', N'PICK', N'DROP') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) GROUP BY action) c ON c.action = a.action ORDER BY a.action

SELECT TOP 4000 CAST(ts AS datetime2) AS time, module_serial AS metric, JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.lastNodeId') AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.lastNodeId'), N'') IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) ORDER BY ts

SELECT DATETRUNC(second, ts) AS time, CONCAT(module_serial, N' driving') AS metric, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.driving')) IN (N'true', N'1') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS FLOAT) AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) GROUP BY DATETRUNC(second, ts), module_serial UNION ALL SELECT DATETRUNC(second, ts) AS time, CONCAT(module_serial, N' paused') AS metric, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(JSON_VALUE(payload_json, '$.paused')) IN (N'true', N'1') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS FLOAT) AS value FROM shopfloor_event WHERE topic LIKE N'fts/%/state' AND module_serial IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (N'__ALL__' IN (${fts:sqlstring}) OR module_serial IN (${fts:sqlstring})) GROUP BY DATETRUNC(second, ts), module_serial ORDER BY 1
